prompt:
超写实室内闪光人像摄影，竖版约 9:16。一名明确成年的东亚女性，20+，侧坐在极简灰色布艺沙发上，摄影者位于人物正前方略偏高位置，使用约 28–35mm 镜头＋机顶直闪，完整拍到头部、身体、双腿和高跟鞋。人物位于画面中央偏左，双腿横向舒展，占据画面中下部。

人物为自然丰满偏沙漏型身材：肩部适中，胸部丰满，腰部明显收束，髋部圆润，大腿根部柔软饱满，腿部修长匀称。不要过度纤瘦，也不要健美肌肉感。

人物斜坐在沙发左侧，上半身略向后靠，左腿屈膝横放在沙发坐垫上，右腿从身体下方向画面右侧大幅伸直，两腿形成交叉叠放结构。右脚延伸到画面右下角，左脚靠近身体。左手轻搭在沙发扶手 / 身侧，右手放在屈起腿部附近，姿态放松自然。

人物留乌黑色超长波浪发，长度到腰部附近，发量浓密，头顶略蓬松；额前为中分偏八字刘海和细碎发丝，两侧头发自然垂落胸前。脸型小巧偏鹅蛋形，肤色白皙，妆容精致：黑色细眼线、自然长睫毛、淡粉腮红、玫瑰裸色唇妆。双眼直视镜头，嘴角轻微上扬，神情冷静柔和。

上身穿黑色蕾丝束身胸衣 / corset top，带明显杯型结构、半透明蕾丝拼接、纵向骨线与收腰设计，肩带较细，腰部紧贴身体。下身穿黑色高叉贴身短裤 / 极短皮质或缎面下装，与上衣统一为全黑造型，保持完整正常覆盖。

双腿穿高光泽烟黑色超薄透明连裤丝袜，约8–12D，明显透出真实肤色，袜面贴肤光滑，受到闪光灯后在大腿、膝盖、小腿和脚背形成非常明显的银白色纵向反光高光线，这是画面重要特征。不要厚黑袜、哑光袜或网袜。

脚穿黑色亮面尖头细高跟鞋，漆皮材质，鞋头狭长，细跟约9–11cm；右脚高跟鞋延伸到画面右下方，略带红色 / 深红色鞋底边缘，左鞋靠近腿部交叠处。

场景为简洁现代室内：一张中灰色织物双人沙发贴着浅灰白色微水泥墙面，墙面有非常轻微裂纹和粗糙纹理；地面为深棕色旧木地板，保留磨损、划痕和木纹。左上角露出一盏黑色大型吊灯灯罩的一部分，形成明显黑色几何前景。

光线采用正面机顶闪光灯＋微弱室内环境光。人物皮肤、丝袜和黑色漆皮鞋被直闪明显提亮，身后墙面出现轻微阴影；背景整体偏暗灰，人物轮廓非常清楚。保留真实闪光摄影的高反差、轻微过曝和局部反光。

整体呈 2000s 数码相机 / 夜间室内直闪写真质感：自然肤质、真实毛孔、轻微颗粒、有限动态范围、低饱和冷灰色调，不要商业棚拍感。

重点锁定：成年东亚女性＋超长黑色波浪发＋黑色蕾丝束身胸衣＋黑色高叉短下装＋高光泽烟黑超薄透明丝袜＋黑色尖头细高跟鞋＋灰色布艺沙发斜坐＋一腿屈膝横放、一腿向右大幅伸直＋机顶直闪＋丝袜明显银白高光＋浅灰墙＋深色旧木地板。

避免：厚黑丝袜、网袜、裸腿、长裤、长裙、运动鞋、粗跟鞋、站姿、双腿并拢、短发、彩色服装、豪华室内、柔光棚拍、强背景虚化、动漫脸、CG感、塑料皮肤、多余肢体、畸形脚、水印和乱码文字。

promptTranslations.en:
Ultra-realistic indoor flash portrait photography, vertical orientation approximately 9:16. An undeniably adult East Asian female, 20+, sitting sideways on a minimalist grey fabric sofa. The photographer is positioned directly in front of the subject, slightly elevated, using an approximately 28–35mm lens with on-camera direct flash, fully capturing the head, torso, legs, and high heels. The subject is placed slightly to the left of the frame center, with her legs stretched out horizontally, occupying the middle and lower sections of the composition.

The subject has a naturally voluptuous, leaning hourglass physique: moderate shoulders, full bust, distinctly nipped waist, rounded hips, soft and full upper thighs, and long, well-proportioned legs. Not overly slender, nor athletic or muscular.

The subject sits slanted on the left side of the sofa, upper body leaning slightly back; her left leg is bent at the knee, resting horizontally across the sofa cushion, while her right leg extends straight outwards from beneath her body far toward the right side of the frame, forming a crossed, overlapping arrangement. The right foot extends to the lower right corner of the frame, and the left foot is close to her body. Her left hand rests gently on the sofa armrest / beside her torso, and her right hand rests near the bent leg, in a relaxed, natural pose.

She has jet-black, ultra-long wavy hair reaching near the waist, thick and voluminous, with slight volume at the crown; center-parted curtain bangs and fine wisps frame her forehead, with strands falling naturally down both sides of her chest. Small, oval-shaped face, fair skin tone, exquisite makeup: thin black eyeliner, naturally long eyelashes, pale pink blush, and rose-nude lip color. Eyes looking directly into the camera, corners of the mouth subtly upturned, with a calm, gentle expression.

Wearing a black lace corset top on the upper body, featuring distinct cup structures, semi-sheer lace paneling, vertical boning lines, and a waist-cinching design, with thin shoulder straps and a snug fit around the waist. On the lower body, black high-cut fitted shorts / ultra-short leather or satin bottoms, matching the top into a cohesive all-black look, maintaining complete, proper coverage.

Her legs are clad in high-shine, smoky-black, ultra-sheer transparent pantyhose, approximately 8–12 denier, distinctly revealing her true skin tone, smooth and skin-tight; under the direct flash, prominent silvery-white vertical reflective highlights form along the thighs, knees, shins, and insteps—a key visual feature of the image. No thick black tights, matte stockings, or fishnets.

On her feet are black glossy pointed-toe stiletto high heels made of patent leather, with a slender, elongated toe and slim heels of about 9–11cm; the right high heel extends toward the lower right of the frame, subtly showing a red / deep crimson sole edge, while the left shoe rests near the intersection of her crossed legs.

The setting is a clean, modern interior: a medium-grey fabric two-seater sofa pressed against a light grey-white microcement wall that has very faint cracks and coarse texture; the floor consists of dark brown vintage wooden planks, retaining scuffs, scratches, and wood grain. A portion of a large black pendant lampshade is visible in the upper left corner, creating a distinct black geometric foreground.

Lighting utilizes a frontal on-camera flash combined with weak indoor ambient light. The subject's skin, pantyhose, and black patent leather shoes are prominently illuminated by the direct flash, casting faint shadows onto the wall behind her; the background is overall muted and dark grey, making the subject's silhouette exceptionally sharp. Retains the high contrast, slight overexposure, and localized specular reflections characteristic of genuine flash photography.

Overall 2000s digital camera / nighttime indoor direct-flash snapshot aesthetic: natural skin texture, authentic pores, slight grain, limited dynamic range, low-saturation cool grey tones; no commercial studio feel.

Key anchors: adult East Asian female + ultra-long black wavy hair + black lace corset top + black high-cut short bottoms + high-gloss smoky-black ultra-sheer transparent pantyhose + black pointed-toe stiletto heels + slanted seated pose on grey fabric sofa + one leg bent horizontally, one leg extended far to the right + on-camera direct flash + prominent silvery-white pantyhose highlights + light grey wall + dark vintage wooden floor.

Avoid: thick black tights, fishnets, bare legs, trousers, long skirts, sneakers, chunky heels, standing poses, legs pressed together, short hair, colorful clothing, luxurious interiors, soft studio lighting, heavy background bokeh, anime face, CG look, plastic skin, extra limbs, malformed feet, watermarks, and garbled text.

summaryTranslations.en: Ultra-realistic indoor direct-flash style portrait prompt, detailing an East Asian woman dressed in a black lace corset, high-shine sheer pantyhose, and pointed stilettos on a grey sofa, specifying pose, camera angle, lighting texture, and compositional details.

双腿穿高光泽烟黑色超薄透明连裤丝袜，约8–12D，明显透出真实肤色，袜面贴肤光滑，受到闪光灯后在大腿、膝盖、小腿和脚背形成非常明显的银白色纵向反光高光线，这是画面重要特征。不要厚黑袜、哑光袜或网袜。

脚穿黑色亮面尖头细高跟鞋，漆皮材质，鞋头狭长，细跟约9–11cm；右脚高跟鞋延伸到画面右下方，略带红色 / 深红色鞋底边缘，左鞋靠近腿部交叠处。

场景为简洁现代室内：一张中灰色织物双人沙发贴着浅灰白色微水泥墙面，墙面有非常轻微裂纹和粗糙纹理；地面为深棕色旧木地板，保留磨损、划痕和木纹。左上角露出一盏黑色大型吊灯灯罩的一部分，形成明显黑色几何前景。

光线采用正面机顶闪光灯＋微弱室内环境光。人物皮肤、丝袜和黑色漆皮鞋被直闪明显提亮，身后墙面出现轻微阴影；背景整体偏暗灰，人物轮廓非常清楚。保留真实闪光摄影的高反差、轻微过曝和局部反光。

整体呈 2000s 数码相机 / 夜间室内直闪写真质感：自然肤质、真实毛孔、轻微颗粒、有限动态范围、低饱和冷灰色调，不要商业棚拍感。

重点锁定：成年东亚女性＋超长黑色波浪发＋黑色蕾丝束身胸衣＋黑色高叉短下装＋高光泽烟黑超薄透明丝袜＋黑色尖头细高跟鞋＋灰色布艺沙发斜坐＋一腿屈膝横放、一腿向右大幅伸直＋机顶直闪＋丝袜明显银白高光＋浅灰墙＋深色旧木地板。

避免：厚黑丝袜、网袜、裸腿、长裤、长裙、运动鞋、粗跟鞋、站姿、双腿并拢、短发、彩色服装、豪华室内、柔光棚拍、强背景虚化、动漫脸、CG感、塑料皮肤、多余肢体、畸形脚、水印和乱码文字。
translations.en:
Photorealistic indoor direct-flash portrait photography, vertical orientation approx 9:16. An East Asian adult woman in her 20s sitting sideways on a minimalist gray fabric sofa. Camera positioned directly in front of the subject, slightly elevated, using a 28–35mm lens with on-camera direct flash, capturing the full body from head to high heels. The woman is situated center-left with legs extended horizontally across the lower frame.

Naturally curvaceous hourglass build: moderate shoulders, full bust, well-defined waist, rounded hips, and slender, toned legs. Wearing a black lace corset top with visible boning structure, paired with high-cut black satin/leather shorts, ultra-sheer high-gloss smokey black pantyhose (8-12D) displaying strong silver-white reflective highlights along the legs, and black patent leather pointed stiletto heels.

Setting is a minimalist modern room: medium-gray fabric couch against a light gray microcement textured wall, dark brown distressed wood flooring, and a visible portion of a black pendant lamp shade in the upper left foreground. Lighting uses direct on-camera flash with faint ambient light, creating sharp contours, natural skin textures, and 2000s digital snapshot camera aesthetics.
